geopolitics_summary: EU energy price tensions dominate Council summit; von der Leyen proposes strategic gas reserves amid winter supply fears; Slovakia's Putin alignment poses gas security risk.

themes.headline: Von der Leyen floats EU strategic gas reserves amid winter supply fears
themes.why_it_matters: Formal proposal for EU-wide strategic reserves signals acceptance of potential winter supply shortfall. Supportive of TTF floor but raises headline risk of supply disruption; implies demand destruction / policy intervention ahead.

themes.headline: Russia plans to revive ties with Slovakia; Fico emerges as Putin's EU ally
themes.why_it_matters: Slovakia's strategic role in EU gas transit via Ukrainian pipelines. Fico–Putin rapprochement raises risk of gas supply disruption or political leverage over EU energy policy; direct TTF upside if flows diverted or threatened.

themes.headline: Ukraine's refinery attacks create leverage risk in Trump Ukraine talks
themes.why_it_matters: Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries constrain crude/fuel supply into Europe; indirect upside for EU power if crude prices spike or if Russian export bans tighten. Relevant to winter fuel adequacy and EUA correlation via energy-mix shifts.

themes.headline: Costa's EU summit splits over energy prices, budget expose council tensions
themes.why_it_matters: Energy price disagreements at Council signal fragmented EU policy response to winter risk. Delays or weak consensus on fiscal / price interventions leave spot markets exposed to supply shocks; increases intra-day / DA spread volatility.

themes.headline: EU methane law implementation failures blamed on both Brussels and member states
themes.why_it_matters: Weak methane enforcement suggests import controls and leakage standards remain loose. Prolonged supply-side leakage and lack of hard targets indirectly supportive of higher gas prices; relevant to long-term LNG dependency and EUA carbon intensity.

watchlist: EU Council consensus on winter energy price policy and strategic reserves deployment (days).
Slovakia–Russia energy & transit negotiations; any signals on gas flow commitments (weeks).
Ukraine refinery strike campaign and impact on EU crude/fuel availability (intraday–weeks).
Methane law enforcement updates from EC; import standard tightening timeline (months).
